sin.name: event-kind-compared
sin.description: A state, a conduct or a listener decides what to do by comparing an event's or an entry's kind, so the behaviour is chosen by a name instead of by the event's class.
sin.rule: Listen to the event's own class with an on_<moment> method or a Listener of that type; to ask what happened before, name the question in the repository that holds the entries.
